facts.text: The resort is set along the shores of Nusa Dua, with seven lagoons flowing through tropical gardens that extend to the beachfront.
facts.excerpt: Set along the shores of Nusa Dua, The Laguna Bali is shaped by seven lagoons that flow through lush tropical gardens, creating a tranquil landscape that extends naturally to the beachfront.

facts.text: The resort has seven lagoon-shaped swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: seven lagoon-shaped swimming pools

facts.text: Rooms offer views of fragrant gardens from private balconies or direct access to the lagoon's warm waters.
facts.excerpt: Guests can unwind with views of lush, fragrant gardens from private balconies or enjoy direct access to the lagoon’s warm waters.

facts.text: In a Lagoon Access Room guests can step from the private balcony directly into the water.
facts.excerpt: the best spot might be in a Lagoon Access Room, which allows you to step from your private balcony directly into the water

facts.text: Rooms feature traditional Balinese decor such as woven keben baskets, used to carry offerings at temples, and low-rise dulang tables with local tropical fruits.
facts.excerpt: Traditional décor includes woven keben baskets, typically used to carry offerings at temples, and low-rise dulang tables that carry colorful spreads of local tropical fruits

facts.text: Specially commissioned artwork in the rooms pays tribute to the island's arts and crafts.
facts.excerpt: specially commissioned artwork pays tribute to the island’s arts and crafts

facts.text: The villas have marble bathrooms and butler service.
facts.excerpt: Each of our Bali villas on Nusa Dua beach has indulgent beds, marble bathrooms and butler service

facts.text: Pool villas each have their own expansive private pool, and a 24-hour butler service is offered.
facts.excerpt: There are also 11 pool villas, each of which boasts its own expansive private pool. A 24-hour butler service ensures guests need not lift a finger while onsite.

facts.text: The Lagoon Spa has indoor treatment rooms, a treatment gazebo overlooking the Indian Ocean and a private relaxation lounge with steam and sauna.
facts.excerpt: our award-winning spa features indoor treatment rooms, a treatment gazebo overlooking the Indian Ocean, and a private relaxation lounge with steam and sauna facilities

facts.text: The Lagoon Spa offers Balinese massages with coconut oil.
facts.excerpt: features indoor treatment rooms, an outdoor gazebo and Balinese massages with coconut oil

facts.text: Lagoon Spa was named Indonesia's Best Resort Spa 2025 and Bali's Best Resort Spa 2025 at the World Spa Awards.
facts.excerpt: Lagoon Spa at The Laguna Bali is honored with the titles of Indonesia’s Best Resort Spa 2025 and Bali’s Best Resort Spa 2025

facts.text: Waterfalls greet guests from the lobby as the lagoon stretches to the beach; there are two sandy beaches, a dedicated pool area and two jacuzzis.
facts.excerpt: Waterfalls welcome you from the lobby of our spa resort in Bali, Indonesia, as the lagoon lazily stretches to the beach. Two sandy beaches, a dedicated pool area, and two jacuzzis entice guests to enjoy the water.

facts.text: On the white sand beach, cabanas offer shade and beachside wellness treatments.
facts.excerpt: cabanas offer tempting respite with cool shade and beachside wellness treatments

facts.text: Arwana is a beachfront grill restaurant whose Basque grills flame-cook seafood and dry-aged meats.
facts.excerpt: A lively and transitional beachfront grill restaurant in Bali with a modern and inviting nautical ambiance, Arwana showcases Basque grills that expertly flame-cook the finest seafood and dry-aged cuts of meat

facts.text: At the cocktail bar guests can watch a Ramayana performance, a Balinese love story combining music, story and dance, over sundowners.
facts.excerpt: a great place to relax for sundowners while watching an indigenous Balinese love story, Ramayana, an extraordinary performance that combines culture, music, story and dance

facts.text: A daily Jamu Ritual is held at 6pm in de Bale Lounge & Bar.
facts.excerpt: Join us at 6:00 PM daily in de Balé Lounge & Bar for our signature Jamu Ritual.

facts.text: Guests can take part in a Balinese blessing ceremony.
facts.excerpt: Through a Balinese blessing ceremony, guests can share in a tradition that has long held a meaningful place in the island’s cultural landscape.

facts.text: Guests can explore Kedonganan fish market accompanied by the resort's chef.
facts.excerpt: Accompanied by our chef, explore Kedonganan fish market and enjoy an opportunity to engage with the local Balinese.

facts.text: Trinity Courts offers tennis, padel and pickleball amid tropical gardens.
facts.excerpt: Play amidst lush tropical gardens at our newly opened Trinity Courts, featuring tennis, padel, and pickleball for both leisure and active pursuits.

facts.text: Kids' activities inspired by Bali's indigenous heritage include natural batik printing, the traditional Deduplak game and clay bottle painting.
facts.excerpt: inspired by Bali’s indigenous heritage featuring natural batik printing, the traditional Deduplak game, & clay bottle painting

facts.text: The resort is within the larger Nusa Dua resort region, on one of Bali's most beautiful beaches.
facts.excerpt: Set within the larger, exclusive Nusa Dua resort region, and on one of Bali’s most beautiful beaches.

facts.text: The resort is a Green Key-certified establishment.
facts.excerpt: The Laguna Bali is a Green Key-certified establishment.

facts.text: The airport is 11 km from the property.
facts.excerpt: Distance from Property: 11.0 KM
